doc.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29

title: Ma Rainey, Bessie Smith and women who ran their own groups
summary: Asked about women blues singers, the men say they never worked with them; the singers had their own groups.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Talk about ruling. That's where they rule you at. Yeah, that's where it is. Incidentally, during your conversation, you've all talked about the boys with whom you've played, and the boys with whom you've brought out. Oh, excuse me. And you haven't mentioned some of the women who are supposed to have made contributions, like Ma Rainey, Bessie Smith, and so on. Were they sort of on the outside of what you people did, or what? With Ma Rainey then? Yeah, those two. Or others. Yeah, quite a few others. Yeah. But no.

They were doing the same thing we were doing, trying to sell their numbers, and they were singing. Did you ever work with them in that sense? No, I never worked with them in the Amos. I never worked with them in the Amos. No. Who did they work with? I guess they had their own groups, you know. Their own groups? Yeah, they didn't. In other words, they didn't join groups that you were with. No, no, no.
